root_cause: measure_v3 lets ANY jamb record consume wall-path length: the overlap of every jamb record is subtracted from each edge before classification, and the record is only afterwards tested for 'physical'. A non-physical opening-side record (CONTINUOUS_WALL_FACE, H518 at the M.B.ROOM / DRESS passage) therefore removed 0.15 of real wall face that no class then counted.
design_error: the design error: ONE record type serves both as an OPENING-SIDE RELATION (what bounds the opening) and as a PHYSICAL SURFACE (what carries a trade); only the second may ever replace wall contact
fix: Separate OPENING_SIDE relations from PHYSICAL_JAMB surfaces. A path span may be consumed ONLY by a jamb record that is physical by positive source evidence (a drawn cap / band end CAPPED / ALIGNED_FREE_END / OPENING_JAMB of an ESTABLISHED band, or a door / glazed-door strip reveal side); a non-physical record is an annotation and never shortens an edge; a topology closure is classified by its own sources and never consumes or creates wall. Every edge length is conserved per site: wall + column + obstacle + window continuity + physical jamb overlap + excluded + withheld = boundary length (checked, not assumed). Trade eligibility is applied after geometry: door / sliding-door jambs = 0, doorless physical jambs counted once.
special_cased: NOTHING: no handle, no project, no site id in the rule (engine/source has no project name)
